sloka: अधर्मानृतसंयुक्तः कामं त्वेष निशाचरः ।तेजस्वी बलवान् शूरो संयुगेषु च नित्यशः ।। ६.११४.९९ ।।
transliteration: adharmānṛtasaṁyuktaḥ kāmaṁ tveṣa niśācaraḥ ।tejasvī balavān śūro saṁyugeṣu ca nityaśaḥ ।। 6.114.99 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas! You are dear to me. It is by your strength I could be victorious. I have to do some kind deed for you.
